packageRules.description: stylelint and its shared configs declare peer ranges on each other, so bumping them separately produces an unsatisfiable tree and Renovate cannot regenerate the lockfile. Always update them in a single PR.
vite and @nextcloud/vite-config move together: vite-config pins the vite major it supports.
Keep the vue stack in one PR. Majors stay separate so a blocked major does not hold back patches.
